---
title: "Reproducible Analysis Checklist"
---

> Run before any submission (manuscript, abstract, dashboard, brief). See Ch. 12.

**Project:** _______________  **Reviewer:** _______________  **Date:** _______________

## Environment
- [ ] Dependencies pinned and recorded (`renv`/lockfile/`environment.yml`)
- [ ] Language/package versions documented
- [ ] Random seed set for any stochastic step

## Code & data
- [ ] Raw data unmodified; all cleaning scripted
- [ ] Relative paths only (no machine-specific absolute paths)
- [ ] Notebooks numbered/ordered; pipeline runs top-to-bottom
- [ ] No restricted data or secrets in the repo

## Outputs
- [ ] Every figure/table/number traces to code
- [ ] Document renders cleanly from a fresh clone
- [ ] Equity-stratified results checked for small-cell disclosure risk

## Validation
- [ ] A second person can clone + reproduce key results
- [ ] Methods text matches the code actually run
- [ ] Preregistration (OSF) referenced if applicable

## Archive (at submission/acceptance)
- [ ] Tagged release / version
- [ ] Deposited (Zenodo/FigShare) with DOI if permissible
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
